# Ear training

Ten minutes of intervals every morning, using an app that plays two notes and asks for the distance. Major thirds and perfect fifths are easy; sevenths and tritones still trip me up. I sing the interval before answering, which anchors the sound in the voice.

Next step is dictation: a short melody played twice, then written down in solfege. Chord qualities come after that, major against minor, then dominant sevenths. Progress is slow but measurable, and the improvement shows when I pick out tunes from the radio at the keyboard.

A tuning fork on the desk helps to keep the reference pitch in mind.
